messages:
maria: Heads-up — v2 rollout scheduled 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC. Deploy-bot already opened a run. Need final pinlist for mobile/EU clients by EOD, and someone to confirm release notes link. cc @leo @aj

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment run created: run-54231. Canary plan: 1% -> 10% over 20m, pause points at 1m/10m/20m. CI: http://ci/internal/runs/54231 :rocket:

leo: Is the mobile header casefold flag included in this rollout? Mobile teams hit header-case mismatch last week, want to keep mobile pinned until 2026-04-01 if any flakiness shows up.

aj: FYI telemetry from yesterday's canary showed a small uptick in 5xxs for long prompts (p95 latency stayed okay). Recommend starting at 1% and holding for 30m on first canary to inspect logs before moving to 10%.

sam: Oncall will watch the rollout. Our abort trigger: error rate > 2% sustained for 5m. If that happens, we abort and rollback to v1. Rollback playbook: /ops/playbooks/v2-rollback.md

maria: Release notes draft (quick):
```
- v2.1.0: header normalization and improved routing
- Clients: include `X-Redwood-Version` to opt into advanced routing
- Backcompat: /v1 endpoints remain supported until 2026-05-01 (see migration guide)
```
Link: https://docs.redwood.example/release/v2.1.0 Please scan and flag anything missing.

leo: Mobile pinlist for immediate apply: tenant-12, tenant-46, tenant-78. I'll push to deploy-bot now.

leo: done. deploy-bot accepted pinlist: tenant-12, tenant-46, tenant-78. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Pinlist applied to run-54231. Canary regions: eu-west, us-west. Observability alerts attached. Notify: @eng-sre, @mobile-team.

aj: Add a specific rollback metric for embeddings endpoint: tokens/sec drop >25% OR latency p95 > 800ms over a 5m window => immediate abort. Also if cache hit rate drops >15% for 10m.

maria: Ack. Documented the extra rollback triggers in run-54231 notes and updated the release notes section. I'll send a final heads-up 1h prior to the window.

sam: I'll be on deck during the window. If anyone wants a pre-run quick sync, ping me. :thumbsup:

leo: quick check — do we need to call out the SDK change in release notes (header normalization) for mobile? I can add a snippet.

maria: Yes please, add a short example and I'll include it in the customer-facing notes. Example snippet below for SDK maintainers:
```js
// add version header to requests
fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Version': 'v2.1.0' } })
```

aj: :eyes: thanks. Also flagging that the canary in eu-west should be limited to 1% tenant traffic for the first 30m due to regional capacity.

maria: Noted and updated. Thanks everyone — final checklist: pinlist applied, rollback triggers recorded, release notes link shared, oncall assigned. I'll post final reminder 60m before start.

sam: Ready. :ok_hand:
